name: Brand Identity System
description: Create a brand as a repeatable system rather than a logo-shaped souvenir.

tasks.name: Define positioning
tasks.objective: Clarify audience, category, promise, proof, personality, competitors, constraints, naming reality, and what the brand must never resemble.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Positioning distinguishes the brand without relying on vague virtues.

tasks.name: Explore identity territories
tasks.objective: Develop multiple genuinely different verbal/visual territories with rationale, references, typography direction, color logic, image language, and failure risks. Avoid cosmetic variants of one idea.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Territories differ in strategic idea, not merely styling.

tasks.name: Build chosen identity system
tasks.objective: Develop marks, wordmark behavior, typography hierarchy, color roles, grids, icon/illustration/photo language, motion principles, tone of voice, and accessibility constraints as reusable rules.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Core identity works in monochrome, small sizes, and constrained formats.
Color and typography choices meet intended accessibility requirements.

tasks.name: Stress-test applications
tasks.objective: Apply the system to representative real contexts including tiny, huge, static, motion, dense-information, social, print, product, and hostile edge cases. Record where rules break.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tests include difficult applications, not only flattering mockups.

tasks.name: Audit distinctiveness and consistency
tasks.objective: Challenge whether outputs are recognizably one brand, accidentally derivative, over-dependent on the logo, inaccessible, or unable to survive content variation. Repair rules rather than hand-correcting every mockup.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Weaknesses are corrected at system level where possible.

tasks.name: Package brand guidelines
tasks.objective: Deliver source assets, tokens/specifications, do/don't examples, templates, voice guidance, provenance/licensing notes, and concise rules sufficient for another designer or agent to extend the system without guessing.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A new application can be produced from the guidelines without reverse-engineering examples.
